methodologyNotes: Published self-serve consumer pricing was collected on the accessed date from each publisher's own US App Store listing, which discloses the exact in-app subscription prices each provider charges; standard monthly/annual rates are recorded and recurring promotional/introductory teaser rates are excluded. All prices are flat per-account per month or per year in USD (no per-seat billing in consumer news subscriptions). HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to news media and are null; annualDiscountPct is computed only where a provider publishes both a monthly and an annual rate; minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier; tiers without a published self-serve price are recorded null.
